summary: Frontend UI validation for Amortizar Capital and Incorporar Juros features on the loan detail page (/emprestimos/3a7cab82-951e-42ba-b79e-b438e7d6bea5) for a 'Sem Prazo / Apenas Juros' active loan. All UI checks passed: menu buttons present, both modals open, dynamic 'Novo capital' updates in real time in both modals, checkboxes present in Incorporar modal. No confirmations performed to preserve seed data.
critical_code_review_comments: Amortizar modal does not close via Escape key. Minor UX; not blocking. Consider adding onKeyDown Escape handler to close modals for accessibility.
test_credentials: qa.teste@gestorcred.com / Teste@2026 (Cloudflare Turnstile in test mode auto-passes)
seed_data_creation: None. Preserved the demo loan state (capital R$ 2.000,00) by not confirming operations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login flow requires ~3s wait for Turnstile widget to render before submitting. Menu 'Mais ações' opens a popup with 'Amortizar Capital' (data-testid=amortizar-btn) and 'Incorporar Juros' (data-testid=incorporar-juros-btn). Modals overlay covers the top-right menu button, so Escape or Cancel is needed before reopening menu. Verified dynamic values: amortizar (2000-800=1.200,00) and incorporar (2000+100=2.100,00 with juros em aberto R$ 200,00). Both checkboxes 'baixar' and 'recalcular' present and checked by default.
